purpose: Part 5/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 030; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the 80-record checkpoint.

items/psychic-676.name: Psychic
items/psychic-676.effectSummary: In the hands of a nonpsionic creature, the weapon is only a nonmagical, nonpsionic masterwork weapon. A psionic wielder gives it an enhancement bonus based on current power-point reserve, changing immediately as the reserve changes: 1-4 points +1, 5-29 +2, 30-79 +3, 80-129 +4, and 130 or more +5.

items/robe-of-useful-items.name: Robe of Useful Items
items/robe-of-useful-items.effectSummary: Only the wearer can see, identify, and detach the robe's patches, one patch per round; a detached patch becomes the actual object and cannot be replaced. A new robe always has two patches each for a dagger, filled and lit bullseye lantern, 2-by-4-foot polished steel mirror, 10-foot pole, 50-foot coil of hempen rope, and sack, plus 4d4 additional random patches. Random results are: 01-08 bag of 100 gp; 09-15 silver coffer worth 500 gp; 16-22 iron door up to 10 by 10 feet that attaches and hinges itself when placed upright; 23-30 ten 100-gp gems; 31-44 24-foot wooden ladder; 45-51 mule with saddlebags; 52-59 open 10-by-10-by-10-foot pit; 60-68 potion of cure serious wounds; 69-75 12-foot rowboat; 76-83 minor scroll of one random spell; 84-90 pair of war dogs treated as riding dogs; 91-96 window 2 by 4 feet and up to 2 feet deep; 97-100 portable ram.

provenance.role: 3.5 SRD cross-check for the catalog page's omitted fixed patches and final portable-ram table row

items/scrolls-uncertain-provenance-642.name: Scrolls of Uncertain Provenance [Relic]
items/scrolls-uncertain-provenance-642.effectSummary: A lawful-neutral, lawful-evil, lawful-good, or neutral possessor gains +5 competence on Knowledge checks. With the relic connection to Wee Jas, the possessor may read for 1 hour once per day; each successful hour requires Knowledge (religion) DC 20 with +2 per language spoken, and read magic, comprehend languages, and Decipher Script do not help. Successful hours accumulate: 1 hour grants renewal pact for self; 2 hours renewal pact for another; 3 hours death pact for self; 4 hours death pact for another; 6 hours true resurrection and the scrolls disappear. Every hour of reading also requires a d% risk roll: 01-10 Will DC 20 or insanity; 11-30 Will DC 20 or greater curse; 31-60 Will DC 20 or receive a geas/quest for Wee Jas; 61-90 gain 1d6 negative levels as energy drain with Fort DC 20 to remove them after 24 hours; 91-100 Fort DC 20 or become a ghost for a year and a day. Relic use requires worship of Wee Jas plus either a sacrificed 6th-level divine spell slot or True Believer with at least 11 HD.

items/seryl-laughing-bow-458.name: Seryl, the Laughing Bow
items/seryl-laughing-bow-458.effectSummary: This intelligent chaotic-good bow is a +2 merciful composite longbow (+4 Strength bonus) made of serren, which gives it the ghost touch quality as a nonmagical material property. It has Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 15, speech, darkvision and hearing 60 feet, Ego 10, speaks Elven, can use faerie fire three times per day, and has 10 ranks each in Diplomacy and Spot for +12 total modifiers. Its personality opposes needless killing and prefers taking prisoners.

items/telkiira.name: Telkiira
items/telkiira.effectSummary: An elf wearer gains +4 insight on Will saves and +4 enhancement to Intelligence. The gem contains 10 ranks in each of four Intelligence-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skills; for those skills the wearer uses either their own ranks or the gem's 10 ranks, whichever is higher, with the wearer's own ability modifier. It functions as an erasable 200-page spellbook; spells take normal time to record but no 25-gp-per-page material cost. It stores up to ten memories of up to 1 hour each with perfect clarity; accessing one recreates the recorder's experience, and recording a memory takes 1 full round. A non-elf or creature without elf blood gains two negative levels and cannot use any abilities while wearing it; the levels vanish on removal. A locked telkiira still grants its Intelligence and Will bonuses but no other benefits. Members of the owning house/clan/family can lock or unlock it as a free action; other wearers can open a lock with Use Magic Device DC 20 or Charisma DC 20, and failure prevents another attempt until gaining a level.

items/temporaljuggler-701.name: Temporal Juggler
items/temporaljuggler-701.effectSummary: This specific psicrown follows the standard psicrown power-trigger rules and contains 850 power points. It can spend those points only on these powers: temporal acceleration, time hop, and timeless body. The wearer may augment those powers with the crown's own points subject to the standard psicrown limit, cannot add personal power points, and may use their own manifester level if it is higher than the crown's.

provenance.role: same-source generic psicrown rules supply activation, augmentation, and manifester-level behavior; this item page supplies the point total and power list

items/the-drilbu-711.name: The Drilbu
items/the-drilbu-711.effectSummary: A drilbu is a 4-to-7-foot crystal shaft weighing about 5 pounds that stores several psionic powers and normally functions as a masterwork quarterstaff; typical physical stats are AC 7, 14 hp, hardness 8, break DC 26. Powers use command-thought activation, usually a standard action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity, or the power's longer manifesting time if applicable. The user must have the power on their class list or have the ability score required to manifest it. On random generation, a 01-30 result means the command thoughts are mentally encoded and whisper themselves to the user on acquisition; 31-100 gives no special quality.

items/torvion-fifth-shield-459.name: Torvion, the Fifth Shield
items/torvion-fifth-shield-459.effectSummary: This intelligent lawful-good item is a +4 angelic light steel shield made of aurorum; if sundered, rejoining the fragments as a full-round action fully restores it. It has Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 13, empathy, 60-foot vision and hearing, Ego 10, understands Celestial, can use bless three times per day, and grants continuous eyes of the avoral to a good-aligned owner. It need not be drawn for the continuous eyes-of-the-avoral benefit.

items/traveler-702.name: Traveler
items/traveler-702.effectSummary: This specific psicrown follows the standard psicrown power-trigger rules and contains 750 power points. It can spend those points only on these powers: astral traveler, psionic dimension door, greater psionic teleport, and psionic teleport. The wearer may augment those powers with the crown's own points subject to the standard psicrown limit, cannot add personal power points, and may use their own manifester level if it is higher than the crown's.

items/zaethwar-sinflayer-460.name: Zaethwar, the Sinflayer
items/zaethwar-sinflayer-460.effectSummary: This intelligent lawful-good adamantine +5 holy spiked chain has Int 17, Wis 10, Cha 17, speech, telepathy, darkvision and hearing 120 feet, Ego 19, and speaks Celestial, Common, Draconic, and Infernal. It can use ease pain three times per day, refreshment three times per day, detect chaotic evil at will, and has 10 ranks in Intimidate for a +13 total modifier. Its special purpose is destroying chaotic-evil creatures, especially demons; it attempts to dominate a wielder who tries to retreat from such foes. If its wielder suffers a pain effect or nonlethal damage, it uses ease pain or refreshment to counter the condition when possible.
